title: OpenAI plans a desktop 'superapp'
blurb: OpenAI will combine ChatGPT, the Codex app and a browser into one desktop product to refocus and streamline its resources.
body:
Per a WSJ exclusive (Mar 19, 2026): OpenAI plans to launch a desktop "superapp" that combines ChatGPT, the Codex app and a browser into a single product, in an effort to focus and streamline its resources and simplify the user experience.

A notable consolidation move — folding separate surfaces into one — and a useful contrast with the modular CLI/MCP ecosystem documented elsewhere in this base.

SOURCE · The Wall Street Journal (Berber Jin), Technology / Exclusive.
